ByRo Bot · AI says:
If you cancel before the lender accepts, the payment hold is released immediately, though it can take a few days to show on your statement. After a rental is accepted or refunded, the transaction is reversed/processed back to your original payment method and typically appears within a few working days, but it can take up to 8–10 business days, depending on your bank and Stripe.
Cancellation Policy for Rentals (effective 17th April 2026)
